annotator: The Gun Violence Corpus authors annotated each event mention with its incident. Round #3130 gave each document one incident: the incident with the most annotated mention tokens (verbose.conll, column 4). One document with a tie was left out.
boundaryRule: One event is one gun-violence incident of the Gun Violence Archive. A document gets the incident with the most annotated mention tokens.

source.name: Gun Violence Corpus, commit 1d80c3a21bb896520dae9e047d70d598279c0df6

source.attribution: Piek Vossen, Filip Ilievski, Marten Postma and Roxane Segers. 2018. Don't Annotate, but Validate: a Data-to-Text Method for Capturing Event Data. In Proceedings of LREC 2018.

weaknesses: 127 of 510 documents mention more than one incident. The most-tokens rule can give such a document the wrong incident.
Suspected label error (zukhruf backlog #3145): incident gvc-338580 holds two Tacoma drive-by articles and the Spokane article "Teen, 17, charged with murder in accidental shooting".
Round #3130 scored this set once as its test. It is a regression set now: do not tune on it.
